---
title: "Data science at each NIH institute"
subtitle: "Institute profiles from the NIH Data Science Taxonomy"
---

For each NIH institute or center, how did data science grow, what brought it there, and where could it do more?

Each profile uses the same layout, so any institute can be compared with another or with the rest of NIH. It shows the institute's data science share over time against the rest of NIH, its fastest-rising topics, how its data science came in (targeted funding opportunities, training awards, and PIs from other institutes), and the areas where its data science share trails the rest of NIH.

Profiles cover the 22 institutes and centers with at least 500 data science projects from FY2016 to FY2025. Counts under 11 are suppressed.

[Back to the NIH Data Science Taxonomy](nih-ds-taxonomy.qmd)
